calculation.expression: rank_cs( log(close/close[-40]) - beta_120(asset,DXY)*log(DXY/DXY[-40]) ) smoothed over 2 sessions
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the rolling 120-session DXY beta contribution from its 40-session log return, then use the centered cross-sectional percentile rank and two-session smoothing. Positive values indicate stronger DXY-neutralized residual trend.

validation.regime_notes: Strong negative predictive relationship is robust over the full sample and recent windows; interpret as a contrarian residual-trend signal when consumed with its empirically negative direction. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative uncertainty interpretation.
